##One-Space Low Pincer
This pincer was used a lot before AI. In modern pro games, pincers like this don't show up that much because AI says that you don't get a good result. From that standpoint, you might say that you shouldn't pincer without a good reason. But this pincer can also lead to a lot of unfamiliar variations. If you know about them, you may get an advantage. (See [AI Masterclass](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-TQy9F8lnhc&t=75s).)

<A:R17> is the most common move.

[Explanation by Go Inside on Youtube (SDK/Dan)](https://youtu.be/fawf6DcCQDc?si=z_v0SAivVbSSdxDe)
